name: Mislead

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: You turn Invisible while an illusory double of you appears where you stand.
text: The invisibility ends right after you attack, deal damage or cast a spell. The double acts as you direct with a Magic action, moving up to twice your Speed, and you can see and hear through its senses.
